description: Checks one title against Etsy's published title rules (up to 140 characters, fewer than 15 words suggested, no price or shipping, occasions only when essential, no repeated words) plus Growtsy's own checks, which are marked as such. Returns publish as is, or the one thing to fix first. Use for 'is my Etsy title OK?' and 'what is the Etsy title character limit?'.
name: etsy_title_check
title: Check an Etsy listing title
